stem: The assigned dry-room destination is unavailable, and no alternate is authorized. What should Technician I do?
choices: Pause the affected transfer and obtain controlled destination authorization before movement
Leave material unlabeled in the hallway
Change the work order after the fact
rationale: Pause the affected transfer and obtain controlled destination authorization before movement. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
